title_en: Guiding Case No. 258: Jinan People's Procuratorate of Shandong Province v. Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. et al. — civil public interest litigation for environmental pollution
ruling_gist_en:
1. Where an environmental protection authority, in the performance of its duties, discovers acts of environmental pollution or ecological damage that pose a significant risk of harming the public interest, and transfers the relevant leads to the People's Procuratorate for filing an environmental civil public interest lawsuit, if such actions comply with the provisions of Article 58 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the people's court shall accept the case in accordance with the law.

2. Where two or more civil subjects who are legally obligated to eliminate the risk of environmental pollution fail to fulfill their corresponding obligations, thereby causing a significant risk of harm to the public interest, and the organ prescribed by the state or the organization prescribed by law requests, in accordance with Article 1171 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, that each civil subject bear joint and several liability for the costs of eliminating the risk, the people's court shall support such request in accordance with the law.

3. To prevent the occurrence or expansion of ecological and environmental damage, the people's court may, based on the circumstances of the case, adopt measures such as injunction and advance enforcement to promptly eliminate the risk of environmental pollution.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 258

Jinan People's Procuratorate, Shandong Province v. Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. et al. — civil public interest litigation for environmental pollution

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, released on May 26, 2025)

Keywords: civil / environmental pollution civil public interest litigation / omission / joint and several liability / injunction / advance execution

Ruling Gist

1. Where an environmental protection authority discovers, in the performance of its duties, conduct that pollutes the environment or damages the ecosystem and poses a significant risk of harming the public interest, and transfers the relevant leads to the People's Procuratorate for the filing of an environmental civil public interest lawsuit, which complies with the provisions of, among others, Article 58 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the People's Court shall accept the case in accordance with the law.

2. Where two or more civil subjects who are legally obligated to eliminate the risk of environmental pollution fail to perform their respective obligations, thereby causing a significant risk of harming the public interest, and the authority prescribed by the state or the organization provided by law requests, in accordance with Article 1171 of the Civil Code of the PRC, that each civil subject bear joint and several liability for the costs of eliminating the danger, the People's Court shall support such a request in accordance with the law.

3. To prevent the occurrence or expansion of ecological and environmental damage, the People's Court may, based on the circumstances of the case, take measures such as issuing an injunction or ordering advance execution to promptly eliminate the risk of environmental pollution.

Basic Facts

In May 2005, a People's Hospital in Jinan, Shandong Province (hereinafter referred to as the "Jinan People's Hospital") partnered with an investment group to establish Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Tumor Hospital"). In December 2008, the Tumor Hospital imported a set of Gamma Knife medical equipment from abroad and obtained a radiation safety license on July 19, 2010. In 2013, the Jinan People's Hospital entered into a "Medical Equipment Lease Agreement" with Jiu Mou Hospital of Jinan City, Shandong Province (hereinafter referred to as the "Jiu Mou Hospital"), stipulating that the medical equipment in question would be leased to Jiu Mou Hospital for a five-year term (from May 1, 2013, to April 30, 2018). Jiu Mou Hospital was to receive income based on the gross revenue of the leased equipment without sharing costs, with the remaining gross revenue belonging to the Jinan People's Hospital. The Jinan People's Hospital was to bear the expenses and operating costs related to the leased equipment and was responsible for handling the necessary licenses for the equipment's use, environmental assessment, and protection. On July 27, 2016, Jiu Mou Hospital and the Jinan People's Hospital entered into a "Termination Agreement for the Medical Equipment Lease Agreement," mutually agreeing to terminate the lease agreement prematurely effective July 31, 2016, and requiring the Jinan People's Hospital to remove the medical equipment in question within two months after termination. During the cooperation period, the Jinan People's Hospital failed to handle the relevant licenses for the equipment's use, environmental assessment, and protection as agreed, and Jiu Mou Hospital also failed to obtain the relevant licenses. Jiu Mou Hospital paid the Jinan People's Hospital a revenue share of RMB 1,982,533.10 (in RMB, same below). After the termination of the cooperation, none of the parties lawfully disposed of the medical equipment in question, which remained idle at Jiu Mou Hospital. The Tumor Hospital had ceased operations for many years and could not afford the disposal costs, and disputes arose with the actual user, the Jinan People's Hospital, and Jiu Mou Hospital regarding the responsibility for disposal, resulting in the failure to lawfully dispose of the medical equipment in question, posing a risk of environmental pollution.

In December 2021, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment, Shandong Province, transferred the above case leads to the Jinan People's Procuratorate, Shandong Province. Upon review, the Jinan People's Procuratorate found that the medical equipment in question had not been disposed of in a timely and lawful manner, creating environmental safety hazards and harming the public interest. On May 30, 2022, it filed an environmental civil public interest lawsuit with the Jinan Intermediate People's Court, requesting that the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, and the Jiu Mou Hospital be ordered to bear the disposal costs of the medical equipment in question in the amount of RMB 2.9 million, and that the Tumor Hospital fulfill the obligation to handle the disposal procedures. Due to the cross-regional jurisdiction for environmental resource cases, the Jinan Intermediate People's Court transferred the case to the Jinan Railway Transport Intermediate People's Court. After accepting the case and to prevent pollution from improper disposal of the medical equipment in question, the Jinan Railway Transport Intermediate People's Court issued an injunction for ecological and environmental protection, ordering the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, and the Jiu Mou Hospital not to dispose of the medical equipment in question without the permission of the court or the competent ecological and environmental authority.

Judgment

The Jinan Railway Transport Intermediate People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2022) Lu 71 Min Chu No. 64 on December 30, 2022: 1. Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd., Jinan Mou People's Hospital, Shandong Province, and Jiu Mou Hospital of Jinan City, Shandong Province, shall jointly pay the disposal costs of the medical equipment in question in the amount of RMB 2.9 million, which shall be paid into the account designated by the court within ten days from the effective date of the judgment; 2. Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. shall fulfill the obligation to handle the disposal procedures within ten days from the effective date of the judgment. After the judgment was pronounced, Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. and Jiu Mou Hospital of Jinan City, Shandong Province, appealed. During the second instance, the Shandong High People's Court ordered advance execution of the disposal costs of the medical equipment in question, recovering RMB 2.9 million from Jinan Mou People's Hospital, Shandong Province. All such funds were used for the decommissioning and disposal of the equipment in question, which was lawfully completed before the case was concluded, thereby eliminating the risk of environmental pollution. The Shandong High People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2023) Lu Min Zhong No. 143 on June 30, 2023, affirming item 2 of the first-instance judgment, i.e., that Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd. shall fulfill the obligation to handle the disposal procedures within ten days from the effective date of the judgment; and modifying item 1 to clarify that Jinan Mou Tumor Hospital Co., Ltd., Jinan Mou People's Hospital, Shandong Province, and Jiu Mou Hospital of Jinan City, Shandong Province, shall bear joint and several liability for the disposal costs of the medical equipment in question in the amount of RMB 2.9 million.

Reasoning

The focus of the dispute in this case is: how should the responsibility for eliminating the risk of environmental pollution from the medical equipment in question be allocated?

Article 1171 of the Civil Code provides: "Where two or more persons commit tortious acts separately, each act is sufficient to cause the entire damage, the actors shall bear joint and several liability." The term "damage" in this article includes not only damage that has already occurred but also an existing real danger of causing damage. Article 179 of the Civil Code stipulates the civil liability method of eliminating danger. Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation (Fa Shi [2015] No. 1, revised in 2020) provides: "For conduct that pollutes the environment or damages the ecosystem and has already harmed the public interest or poses a significant risk of harming the public interest, the plaintiff may request that the defendant bear civil liability such as cessation of infringement, removal of obstacles, elimination of danger, restoration of the ecological environment, compensation for losses, and apology." In this case, the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, and the Jiu Mou Hospital failed to fulfill their obligations for risk control. Each of their tortious acts was sufficient to cause the danger of environmental pollution, and they shall bear joint and several liability in accordance with the aforementioned provisions of the Civil Code.

First, with respect to the tortious acts, the medical equipment in question had been idle for a long time. According to relevant legal provisions, it should have been returned to the original exporter or sent to a specialized unit for the storage or disposal of such solid waste, and could not be left unattended. As the user of the medical equipment in question authorized by the competent administrative department, the Tumor Hospital had a legal obligation to provide safety protection and dispose of idle equipment. The Jinan People's Hospital and the Jiu Mou Hospital, as actual users who had not lawfully handled the change of use permits and had used the medical equipment in question without authorization, also had an obligation to eliminate the danger of environmental pollution arising from the idle medical equipment in question. The failure of the above entities to dispose of the medical equipment in question were independent acts, each involving fault, and constituted separate tortious acts of failing to perform statutory obligations.

Second, with respect to the consequences of damage, the failure of the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, and the Jiu Mou Hospital to lawfully dispose of the medical equipment in question resulted in a significant risk of environmental pollution, constituting a case of causing the same existing danger. In particular, the risk of environmental pollution and ecological damage in this case was sudden, instantaneous, and irreversible, and the harmful consequences had characteristics of lag, longevity, and difficulty in remediation. Based on this, effective relief should be provided even when the infringement is ongoing or the actual damage has not yet finally occurred. In this case, the failure to lawfully dispose of the special medical equipment in question in a timely manner can be found to constitute a significant risk of harming the public interest as provided in Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation.

Third, with respect to causation, if any one of the tortfeasors—the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, or the Jiu Mou Hospital—had actively fulfilled its obligation to dispose of the medical equipment in question, it would have been sufficient to prevent the occurrence of the environmental pollution danger. Conversely, the respective failures of the above entities to lawfully dispose of the equipment were each sufficient to result in the consequence of the medical equipment in question creating an environmental pollution danger.

In summary, the costs of RMB 2.9 million to eliminate the potential danger from the medical equipment in question shall be borne jointly and severally by the Tumor Hospital, the Jinan People's Hospital, and the Jiu Mou Hospital, in accordance with Article 1171 of the Civil Code.

Furthermore, given the hazardous nature of the risk posed by the medical equipment in question, and in accordance with the principle of "protection first and prevention-oriented" set forth in the Environmental Protection Law of the PRC, the People's Court promptly issued a preservation measure in the form of an injunction based on the specific circumstances of the case to prevent the occurrence or expansion of ecological and environmental damage. During the second-instance trial, the court also ordered advance execution of the disposal costs, thereby timely eliminating the risk of environmental pollution.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 179 and Article 1171 of the Civil Code of the PRC

Article 58 and Article 109 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC

Article 1 and Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation (Fa Shi [2015] No. 1, revised in 2020)

Article 1 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Injunction Preservation Measures in Cases Involving Ecological and Environmental Infringement (Fa Shi [2021] No. 22)
